provenance.dual_target_interval_results: results/review_r5/eu_obs_backtest.csv; code/eu_obs_backtest.py specifies 600 warmup + 600 retained draws per window. This is the newer dual-target run.
provenance.bootstrap: results/ar_bootstrap_baseline.csv; 2,000 residual bootstrap draws; exact 53 geo-window targets matched to dual-target CSV.
provenance.point_MdAPE: results/eu_forecast_W1.csv and results/eu_forecast_W2.csv; code/w3_eu_forecast.py specifies 800 warmup + 800 retained draws per window. Kept distinct from newer 600+600 dual-target intervals. Persistence prediction is the last training observation.
provenance.logs: archived logs are not shipped; see code/eu_obs_backtest.py and code/w3_eu_forecast.py for the corresponding run specifications

definitions.coverage: fraction of held-out TOTAL_HH report values inside nominal 90% interval

prior_sensitivity.status_at_audit: incomplete; no completed fit outputs [historical snapshot; superseded by results/review_r7/eu_prior/ (baseline and loc0 arms completed)]
prior_sensitivity.actually_started: baseline full-panel arm logB_loc=-0.2, NumPyro NUTS, JAX float64, two sequential chains, 600 warmup and 600 retained draws per chain, seed 20261020; process was still present at last status check
prior_sensitivity.diagnostics_deltas_metadata: available in results/review_r7/eu_prior/ (run_metadata.json and {baseline,loc0}_diagnostics.csv); not written at the time of the historical audit

limitations: The 53 pairs span two forecast origins; empirical coverage is descriptive, not independent external validation.
Held-out official TOTAL_HH is a reported proxy target, not known latent truth.
Relative interval width above one means the median interval span exceeds the held-out value; width alone does not establish accuracy or calibration.
